note: Integrity analysis of the independent H-B3 seeding agent's tool log (protocol 2026-11-03-hb3.md step 7), by bench/pilot/hb2/audit-agent-log.js (generalised for H-B3) and a cross-check of every tool input and result for markers of the measured code. The log itself stays outside the repository (it contains the seeds' working ids and descriptions); its hash is recorded. No item was exempted in the tool: it still says independent: false, and each flagged item is adjudicated here.

adjudication.what: a pre-seal validation script ended with: ls /root/.cache/eccode/hb3-seeds.key >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "key file exists (not read)"
adjudication.verdict: an existence check of the key file by path, output discarded; the key was not opened, read, copied or printed (key value present in the log: 0)

adjudication.what: ps aux filtered by grep for pytest processes, in the default working directory
adjudication.verdict: a process listing that opens no file; its results contain no marker of the repository

markerCrossCheck.note: Markers searched in every input and result: /home/user/ECCode, eccode (as a path component it also matches the cache directory /root/.cache/eccode), probe_runner, behavior diff / behavior.json / lib/behavior, exampleIds, hb2 / hb3 / phase2, bench/, detector, scratchpad, claude-0, frozen. Findings: (1) the only repository paths in any input are the one sealing command (hb3/seal.js, the out-dir and the key file); (2) /home/user/ECCode and the harness path /tmp/claude-0/... appear in results only as the harness line that announces a background command (Output is being written to ..., Session cwd remains /home/user/ECCode), never as file content; (3) FROZEN is the agent's own environment variable UV_FROZEN; (4) no result contains the name or content of a detector, probe, configuration or test file of the repository under measurement.

deviationsFromTheBrief: After sealing (15:28:12) and cleaning its scratch, the agent ran: ls .../tasks/ | wc -l; rm -f .../tasks/*.output; ls .../scratchpad | wc -l (the session's harness directories, not the repository). The count of entries of the session scratchpad was requested and its output was lost with the deleted file; no file of the scratchpad was read. The deletion removed the output files of this session's own background commands (its own and the implementer's); nothing the measurement needs lived there. The seeds were already sealed; this cannot have influenced them. It was outside the brief (which named the Mealie checkout and its scratch directory) and is reported as a deviation.
conclusion: No read, listing or search of any detector, probe, configuration or test file of the repository under measurement, no read of the key. H-B3 is NOT marked non-independent. The independence of the agent rests on its brief and on this analysis, not on a technical barrier (register row 183).

sealed.agentReport: every sealed seed shown on the unpatched and the patched application through Mealie's test client; the backend suite (about 3,581 tests in unit_tests, integration_tests, multitenant_tests, with --dist loadfile) passes with the seeds, applied in groups; candidates that broke it were dropped
